    {
      "unit": "F000",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of title 42, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan in accordance with the provisions of chapter 106 of title 42 (as in effect on the day before October 27, 1998), rather than the provisions of subsections (a) through (c) relating to applications and plans.",
        "actor": "a State",
        "actor_quote": "a State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F000"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9905", "section 9906"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F018:F020",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "If any geographic area of a State is not, or ceases to be, served by an eligible entity under chapter 106 of title 42, and if the chief executive officer of the State decides to serve such area, the chief executive officer may solicit applications from, and designate as an eligible entity, either a private nonprofit organization (which may include an eligible entity) that is geographically located in the unserved area, that is capable of providing a broad range of services designed to eliminate poverty and foster self-sufficiency, and that meets the requirements of chapter 106, or a private nonprofit eligible entity that is geographically located in an area contiguous to or within reasonable proximity of the unserved area and that is already providing related services in the unserved area.",
        "actor": "the chief executive officer of the State",
        "actor_quote": "the chief executive officer of the State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "If any geographic area of a State is not, or ceases to be, served by an eligible entity under this chapter, and if the chief executive officer of the State decides to serve such area",
        "scope_quotes": ["F018"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F022:F024",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order to serve as the eligible entity for the area, a private nonprofit eligible entity that is geographically located in an area contiguous to or within reasonable proximity of the unserved area and that is already providing related services in the unserved area shall agree to add additional members to the board of the entity to ensure adequate representation in each of the three required categories described in section 9910(a)(2)(A), (B), and (C) of title 42 by members that reside in the community comprised by the unserved area, and in the category described in section 9910(a)(2)(B) of title 42 by members that reside in the neighborhood to be served.",
        "actor": "an entity described in paragraph (1)(B)",
        "actor_quote": "an entity described in paragraph (1)(B)",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order to serve as the eligible entity for the area",
        "scope_quotes": ["F022"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9910(a)(2)", "section 9910(a)(2)(B)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In designating an eligible entity under 42 U.S.C. 9909(a), the chief executive officer shall grant the designation to an organization of demonstrated effectiveness in meeting the goals and purposes of chapter 106 of title 42.",
        "actor": "the chief executive officer",
        "actor_quote": "the chief executive officer",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In designating an eligible entity under subsection (a)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F027"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F027",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In designating an eligible entity under 42 U.S.C. 9909(a), the chief executive officer may give priority, in granting the designation, to eligible entities that are providing related services in the unserved area, consistent with the needs identified by a community-needs assessment.",
        "actor": "the chief executive officer",
        "actor_quote": "the chief executive officer",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "In designating an eligible entity under subsection (a)",
        "scope_quotes": ["F027"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F030",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "If no private, nonprofit organization is identified or determined to be qualified under subsection (a) of 42 U.S.C. 9909 to serve the unserved area as an eligible entity, the chief executive officer may designate an appropriate political subdivision of the State to serve as an eligible entity for the area.",
        "actor": "the chief executive officer",
        "actor_quote": "the chief executive officer",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": "If no private, nonprofit organization is identified or determined to be qualified under subsection (a) to serve the unserved area as an eligible entity",
        "scope_quotes": ["F030"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F030",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order to serve as the eligible entity for that area under 42 U.S.C. 9909(c), the political subdivision shall have a board or other mechanism as required in section 9910(b) of title 42.",
        "actor": "the political subdivision",
        "actor_quote": "the political subdivision",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order to serve as the eligible entity for that area",
        "scope_quotes": ["F030"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9910(b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F040",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of title 42, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board described in 42 U.S.C. 9910(a)(2) that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.",
        "actor": "the entity",
        "actor_quote": "the entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F040"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9902(1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F042:F047",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The members of the tripartite board referred to in 42 U.S.C. 9910(a)(1) shall be selected by the entity and the board shall be composed so as to assure that: (A) ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials, holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives, except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement; (B)(i) not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, and (ii) each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member; and (C) the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.",
        "actor": "the entity",
        "actor_quote": "the entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": ["F040"],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F049:F055",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of title 42, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through either: (1) a tripartite board, which shall have members selected by the organization and shall be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, reside in the neighborhood served, and are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under chapter 106; or (2) another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under chapter 106.",
        "actor": "the entity",
        "actor_quote": "the entity",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title",
        "scope_quotes": ["F049"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9902(1)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F067:F070",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["indian_tribe", "tribal_organization"],
        "statement": "If, with respect to any State, the Secretary receives a request from the governing body of an Indian tribe or tribal organization within the State that assistance under chapter 106 of title 42 be made directly to such tribe or organization, and determines that the members of such tribe or tribal organization would be better served by means of grants made directly to provide benefits under chapter 106, the Secretary shall reserve from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State under section 9906 of title 42 for the fiscal year the amount determined under 42 U.S.C. 9911(b).",
        "actor": "the Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "the Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "If, with respect to any State, the Secretary— (1) receives a request from the governing body of an Indian tribe or tribal organization within the State that assistance under this chapter be made directly to such tribe or organization; and (2) determines that the members of such tribe or tribal organization would be better served by means of grants made directly to provide benefits under this chapter",
        "scope_quotes": ["F067:F069"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9906", "subsection (b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F072",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["indian"],
        "statement": "The Secretary shall reserve for the purpose of 42 U.S.C. 9911(a) from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State, not less than 100 percent of an amount that bears the same ratio to the State allotment for the fiscal year involved as the population of all eligible Indians for whom a determination has been made under subsection (a) bears to the population of all individuals eligible for assistance through a community services block grant made under chapter 106 of title 42 in such State.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "for the purpose of subsection (a) from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State",
        "scope_quotes": ["F072"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F075",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["indian_tribe", "tribal_organization"],
        "statement": "The sums reserved by the Secretary on the basis of a determination made under 42 U.S.C. 9911(a) shall be made available by grant to the Indian tribe or tribal organization serving the individuals for whom such a determination has been made.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["subsection (a)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F078",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": ["indian_tribe", "tribal_organization"],
        "statement": "In order for an Indian tribe or tribal organization to be eligible for a grant award for a fiscal year under 42 U.S.C. 9911, the tribe or organization shall submit to the Secretary a plan for such fiscal year that meets such criteria as the Secretary may prescribe by regulation.",
        "actor": "the tribe or organization",
        "actor_quote": "the tribe or organization",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order for an Indian tribe or tribal organization to be eligible for a grant award for a fiscal year under this section",
        "scope_quotes": ["F078"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F081:F082",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "indian_tribe",
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In section 9911 of title 42, the terms “Indian tribe” and “tribal organization” mean a tribe, band, or other organized group recognized in the State in which the tribe, band, or group resides, or considered by the Secretary of the Interior, to be an Indian tribe or an Indian organization for any purpose.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this section",
        "scope_quotes": ["F080"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F084:F085",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": "indian",
        "term_refs": ["indian_tribe", "tribal_organization"],
        "statement": "In section 9911 of title 42, the term “Indian” means a member of an Indian tribe or of a tribal organization.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "definition",
        "modality": "not_stated",
        "scope_text": "In this section",
        "scope_quotes": ["F080"],
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": null,
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,

        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F096",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall carry out the functions of chapter 106 of title 42 through an Office of Community Services, which shall be established in the Department of Health and Human Services and shall be headed by a Director.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,

        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F099",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall carry out functions of chapter 106 of title 42 through grants, contracts, or cooperative agreements.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,

        "alternative_quotes": null,

        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F108:F110",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall use amounts reserved in section 9903(b)(2) of title 42: (A) for training, technical assistance, planning, evaluation, and performance measurement, to assist States in carrying out corrective action activities and monitoring (to correct programmatic deficiencies of eligible entities), and for reporting and data collection activities, related to programs carried out under chapter 106; and (B) to distribute amounts in accordance with 42 U.S.C. 9913(c).",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9903(b)(2)", "subsection (c)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F113",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The activities described in 42 U.S.C. 9913(a)(1)(A) may be carried out by the Secretary through grants, contracts, or cooperative agreements with appropriate entities.",
        "actor": "the Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "the Secretary",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": ["F108:F109"],
        "modality_quote": "may",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["paragraph (1)(A)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F115:F117",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The process for determining the training and technical assistance to be carried out under section 9913 of title 42 shall: (1) ensure that the needs of eligible entities and programs relating to improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices) are addressed to the maximum extent feasible; and (2) incorporate mechanisms to ensure responsiveness to local needs, including an ongoing procedure for obtaining input from the national and State networks of eligible entities.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F121",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The amounts reserved under section 9903(b)(2)(A) of title 42 for activities to be carried out under 42 U.S.C. 9913(c) shall be distributed directly to eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in paragraph (2) for the purpose of improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices), management information and reporting systems, and measurement of program results, and for the purpose of ensuring responsiveness to identified local needs.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9903(b)(2)(A)", "paragraph (2)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F124",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "Eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in 42 U.S.C. 9913(c)(2) shall be eligible entities, or statewide or local organizations or associations, with demonstrated expertise in providing training to individuals and organizations on methods of effectively addressing the needs of low-income families and communities.",
        "actor": null,
        "actor_quote": null,
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": ["F121"],
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": null
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F128:F132",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "In order to determine whether eligible entities meet the performance goals, administrative standards, financial management requirements, and other requirements of a State, the State shall conduct the following reviews of eligible entities: (1) a full onsite review of each such entity at least once during each 3-year period; (2) an onsite review of each newly designated entity immediately after the completion of the first year in which such entity receives funds through the community services block grant program; (3) followup reviews including prompt return visits to eligible entities, and their programs, that fail to meet the goals, standards, and requirements established by the State; and (4) other reviews as appropriate, including reviews of entities with programs that have had other Federal, State, or local grants (other than assistance provided under chapter 106) terminated for cause.",
        "actor": "the State",
        "actor_quote": "the State",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": "In order to determine whether eligible entities meet the performance goals, administrative standards, financial management requirements, and other requirements of a State",
        "scope_quotes": ["F128"],
        "context_quotes": null,

        "choice_text": null,

      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F135",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The State may request training and technical assistance from the Secretary as needed to comply with the requirements of section 9914 of title 42.",
        "actor": "The State",
        "actor_quote": "The State",
        "kind": "permission",
        "modality": "may",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,

        "references": ["this section"]
      }

    {
      "unit": "F138",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,
        "statement": "The Secretary shall conduct in several States in each fiscal year evaluations (including investigations) of the use of funds received by the States under chapter 106 of title 42 in order to evaluate compliance with the provisions of chapter 106, and especially with respect to compliance with section 9908(b) of title 42.",
        "actor": "The Secretary",
        "actor_quote": "The Secretary",
        "kind": "requirement",
        "modality": "must",
        "scope_text": null,
        "scope_quotes": null,
        "context_quotes": null,
        "modality_quote": "shall",
        "choice_text": null,
        "choice_quote": null,
        "alternative_quotes": null,
        "logic_quote": null,
        "references": ["section 9908(b)"]
      }
    },
    {
      "unit": "F138",
      "unit_attributes": {
        "defines_term": null,
        "term_refs": null,

unit_attributes.statement: For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of title 42, a State shall prepare and submit to the Secretary an application and State plan in accordance with the provisions of chapter 106 of title 42 (as in effect on the day before October 27, 1998), rather than the provisions of subsections (a) through (c) relating to applications and plans.
unit_attributes.scope_text: For fiscal year 2000, to be eligible to receive a grant or allotment under section 9905 or 9906 of this title

unit_attributes.statement: If any geographic area of a State is not, or ceases to be, served by an eligible entity under chapter 106 of title 42, and if the chief executive officer of the State decides to serve such area, the chief executive officer may solicit applications from, and designate as an eligible entity, either a private nonprofit organization (which may include an eligible entity) that is geographically located in the unserved area, that is capable of providing a broad range of services designed to eliminate poverty and foster self-sufficiency, and that meets the requirements of chapter 106, or a private nonprofit eligible entity that is geographically located in an area contiguous to or within reasonable proximity of the unserved area and that is already providing related services in the unserved area.
unit_attributes.actor: the chief executive officer of the State
unit_attributes.actor_quote: the chief executive officer of the State
unit_attributes.scope_text: If any geographic area of a State is not, or ceases to be, served by an eligible entity under this chapter, and if the chief executive officer of the State decides to serve such area

unit_attributes.statement: In order to serve as the eligible entity for the area, a private nonprofit eligible entity that is geographically located in an area contiguous to or within reasonable proximity of the unserved area and that is already providing related services in the unserved area shall agree to add additional members to the board of the entity to ensure adequate representation in each of the three required categories described in section 9910(a)(2)(A), (B), and (C) of title 42 by members that reside in the community comprised by the unserved area, and in the category described in section 9910(a)(2)(B) of title 42 by members that reside in the neighborhood to be served.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order to serve as the eligible entity for the area

unit_attributes.statement: In designating an eligible entity under 42 U.S.C. 9909(a), the chief executive officer shall grant the designation to an organization of demonstrated effectiveness in meeting the goals and purposes of chapter 106 of title 42.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In designating an eligible entity under subsection (a)

unit_attributes.statement: In designating an eligible entity under 42 U.S.C. 9909(a), the chief executive officer may give priority, in granting the designation, to eligible entities that are providing related services in the unserved area, consistent with the needs identified by a community-needs assessment.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In designating an eligible entity under subsection (a)

unit_attributes.statement: If no private, nonprofit organization is identified or determined to be qualified under subsection (a) of 42 U.S.C. 9909 to serve the unserved area as an eligible entity, the chief executive officer may designate an appropriate political subdivision of the State to serve as an eligible entity for the area.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If no private, nonprofit organization is identified or determined to be qualified under subsection (a) to serve the unserved area as an eligible entity

unit_attributes.statement: In order to serve as the eligible entity for that area under 42 U.S.C. 9909(c), the political subdivision shall have a board or other mechanism as required in section 9910(b) of title 42.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order to serve as the eligible entity for that area

unit_attributes.statement: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of title 42, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through a tripartite board described in 42 U.S.C. 9910(a)(2) that fully participates in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of the program to serve low-income communities.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order for a private, nonprofit entity to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title

unit_attributes.statement: The members of the tripartite board referred to in 42 U.S.C. 9910(a)(1) shall be selected by the entity and the board shall be composed so as to assure that: (A) ⅓ of the members of the board are elected public officials, holding office on the date of selection, or their representatives, except that if the number of such elected officials reasonably available and willing to serve on the board is less than ⅓ of the membership of the board, membership on the board of appointive public officials or their representatives may be counted in meeting such ⅓ requirement; (B)(i) not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, and (ii) each representative of low-income individuals and families selected to represent a specific neighborhood within a community under clause (i) resides in the neighborhood represented by the member; and (C) the remainder of the members are officials or members of business, industry, labor, religious, law enforcement, education, or other major groups and interests in the community served.

In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of title 42, the entity shall administer the community services block grant program through either: (1) a tripartite board, which shall have members selected by the organization and shall be composed so as to assure that not fewer than ⅓ of the members are persons chosen in accordance with democratic selection procedures adequate to assure that these members are representative of low-income individuals and families in the neighborhood served, reside in the neighborhood served, and are able to participate actively in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under chapter 106; or (2) another mechanism specified by the State to assure decisionmaking and participation by low-income individuals in the development, planning, implementation, and evaluation of programs funded under chapter 106.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order for a public organization to be considered to be an eligible entity for purposes of section 9902(1) of this title

unit_attributes.statement: If, with respect to any State, the Secretary receives a request from the governing body of an Indian tribe or tribal organization within the State that assistance under chapter 106 of title 42 be made directly to such tribe or organization, and determines that the members of such tribe or tribal organization would be better served by means of grants made directly to provide benefits under chapter 106, the Secretary shall reserve from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State under section 9906 of title 42 for the fiscal year the amount determined under 42 U.S.C. 9911(b).
unit_attributes.scope_text: If, with respect to any State, the Secretary— (1) receives a request from the governing body of an Indian tribe or tribal organization within the State that assistance under this chapter be made directly to such tribe or organization; and (2) determines that the members of such tribe or tribal organization would be better served by means of grants made directly to provide benefits under this chapter

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall reserve for the purpose of 42 U.S.C. 9911(a) from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State, not less than 100 percent of an amount that bears the same ratio to the State allotment for the fiscal year involved as the population of all eligible Indians for whom a determination has been made under subsection (a) bears to the population of all individuals eligible for assistance through a community services block grant made under chapter 106 of title 42 in such State.
unit_attributes.scope_text: for the purpose of subsection (a) from amounts that would otherwise be allotted to such State

unit_attributes.statement: The sums reserved by the Secretary on the basis of a determination made under 42 U.S.C. 9911(a) shall be made available by grant to the Indian tribe or tribal organization serving the individuals for whom such a determination has been made.

In order for an Indian tribe or tribal organization to be eligible for a grant award for a fiscal year under 42 U.S.C. 9911, the tribe or organization shall submit to the Secretary a plan for such fiscal year that meets such criteria as the Secretary may prescribe by regulation.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order for an Indian tribe or tribal organization to be eligible for a grant award for a fiscal year under this section

unit_attributes.statement: In section 9911 of title 42, the terms “Indian tribe” and “tribal organization” mean a tribe, band, or other organized group recognized in the State in which the tribe, band, or group resides, or considered by the Secretary of the Interior, to be an Indian tribe or an Indian organization for any purpose.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this section

unit_attributes.statement: In section 9911 of title 42, the term “Indian” means a member of an Indian tribe or of a tribal organization.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In this section

unit_attributes.statement: The Secretary shall carry out the functions of chapter 106 of title 42 through an Office of Community Services, which shall be established in the Department of Health and Human Services and shall be headed by a Director.
The Secretary shall carry out functions of chapter 106 of title 42 through grants, contracts, or cooperative agreements.

The Secretary shall use amounts reserved in section 9903(b)(2) of title 42: (A) for training, technical assistance, planning, evaluation, and performance measurement, to assist States in carrying out corrective action activities and monitoring (to correct programmatic deficiencies of eligible entities), and for reporting and data collection activities, related to programs carried out under chapter 106; and (B) to distribute amounts in accordance with 42 U.S.C. 9913(c).
The activities described in 42 U.S.C. 9913(a)(1)(A) may be carried out by the Secretary through grants, contracts, or cooperative agreements with appropriate entities.

The process for determining the training and technical assistance to be carried out under section 9913 of title 42 shall: (1) ensure that the needs of eligible entities and programs relating to improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices) are addressed to the maximum extent feasible; and (2) incorporate mechanisms to ensure responsiveness to local needs, including an ongoing procedure for obtaining input from the national and State networks of eligible entities.

The amounts reserved under section 9903(b)(2)(A) of title 42 for activities to be carried out under 42 U.S.C. 9913(c) shall be distributed directly to eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in paragraph (2) for the purpose of improving program quality (including quality of financial management practices), management information and reporting systems, and measurement of program results, and for the purpose of ensuring responsiveness to identified local needs.

Eligible entities, organizations, or associations described in 42 U.S.C. 9913(c)(2) shall be eligible entities, or statewide or local organizations or associations, with demonstrated expertise in providing training to individuals and organizations on methods of effectively addressing the needs of low-income families and communities.

In order to determine whether eligible entities meet the performance goals, administrative standards, financial management requirements, and other requirements of a State, the State shall conduct the following reviews of eligible entities: (1) a full onsite review of each such entity at least once during each 3-year period; (2) an onsite review of each newly designated entity immediately after the completion of the first year in which such entity receives funds through the community services block grant program; (3) followup reviews including prompt return visits to eligible entities, and their programs, that fail to meet the goals, standards, and requirements established by the State; and (4) other reviews as appropriate, including reviews of entities with programs that have had other Federal, State, or local grants (other than assistance provided under chapter 106) terminated for cause.
unit_attributes.scope_text: In order to determine whether eligible entities meet the performance goals, administrative standards, financial management requirements, and other requirements of a State

unit_attributes.statement: The State may request training and technical assistance from the Secretary as needed to comply with the requirements of section 9914 of title 42.

The Secretary shall conduct in several States in each fiscal year evaluations (including investigations) of the use of funds received by the States under chapter 106 of title 42 in order to evaluate compliance with the provisions of chapter 106, and especially with respect to compliance with section 9908(b) of title 42.

The Secretary shall submit, to each State evaluated, a report containing the results of such evaluations, and recommendations of improvements designed to enhance the benefit and impact of the activities carried out with such funds for people in need.
On receiving the report of evaluations conducted under 42 U.S.C. 9914(c), the State shall submit to the Secretary a plan of action in response to the recommendations contained in the report.
unit_attributes.scope_text: On receiving the report

unit_attributes.statement: The results of the evaluations conducted under 42 U.S.C. 9914(c) shall be submitted annually to the Chairperson of the Committee on Education and the Workforce of the House of Representatives and the Chairperson of the Committee on Labor and Human Resources of the Senate (now the Committee on Health, Education, Labor, and Pensions of the Senate) as part of the report submitted by the Secretary in accordance with section 9917(b)(2) of title 42.

If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of title 42, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under chapter 106 of title 42 or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives), the State shall: (1) inform the entity of the deficiency to be corrected; (2) require the entity to correct the deficiency; (3) offer training and technical assistance, if appropriate, to help correct the deficiency, and prepare and submit to the Secretary a report describing the training and technical assistance offered, or if the State determines that such training and technical assistance are not appropriate, prepare and submit to the Secretary a report stating the reasons for the determination; (4) at the discretion of the State (taking into account the seriousness of the deficiency and the time reasonably required to correct the deficiency), allow the entity to develop and implement, within 60 days after being informed of the deficiency, a quality improvement plan to correct such deficiency within a reasonable period of time, as determined by the State, and not later than 30 days after receiving from an eligible entity a proposed quality improvement plan pursuant to subparagraph (A), either approve such proposed plan or specify the reasons why the proposed plan cannot be approved; and (5) after providing adequate notice and an opportunity for a hearing, initiate proceedings to terminate the designation of or reduce the funding under chapter 106 of the eligible entity unless the entity corrects the deficiency.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the State determines, on the basis of a final decision in a review pursuant to section 9914 of this title, that an eligible entity fails to comply with the terms of an agreement, or the State plan, to provide services under this chapter or to meet appropriate standards, goals, and other requirements established by the State (including performance objectives)

unit_attributes.statement: A determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is reviewable by the Secretary.

The Secretary shall, upon request, review a determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity, and the review shall be completed not later than 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation relating to the determination.
unit_attributes.scope_text: upon request

unit_attributes.statement: If the Secretary's review of a determination to terminate the designation or reduce the funding of an eligible entity is not completed within 90 days after the Secretary receives from the State all necessary documentation, the determination of the State shall become final at the end of the 90th day.
unit_attributes.scope_text: If the review is not completed within 90 days

unit_attributes.statement: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of title 42 and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in 42 U.S.C. 9915(b), the Secretary is authorized to provide financial assistance under chapter 106 of title 42 to the eligible entity affected until the violation is corrected.
unit_attributes.scope_text: Whenever a State violates the assurances contained in section 9908(b)(8) of this title and terminates or reduces the funding of an eligible entity prior to the completion of the State hearing described in that section and the Secretary’s review as required in subsection (b)

unit_attributes.statement: Whenever financial assistance is provided to an eligible entity under 42 U.S.C. 9915(c) following a State's violation of assurances under section 9908(b)(8) and termination or reduction of funding prior to the completion of the State hearing and the Secretary's review, the grant or allotment for the State under section 9905 or 9906 of title 42 for the earliest appropriate fiscal year shall be reduced by an amount equal to the funds provided under 42 U.S.C. 9915(c) to such eligible entity.
